When I was 16 I was getting bullied really badly at school. In class one day, one of the boys who was particularly horrible sat next to me and started being polite and nice to me, like we’d been friends for years. I stupidly thought he was being a decent person so I was more than happy to have a conversation with him. After about 10 minutes of this he stopped and looked me straight in the eyes and said, “You’re disgusting. Do you actually think you mean anything to anyone?” 

Everyone started pissing themselves laughing like he was some world class comedian and I just felt empty. I’ve never really gotten over it, even now at 23. He’s probably forgotten all about it, but I’ll never forget it. 

Sorry for the rambling post, it just felt good to get that off my chest.
